system.description: With merely a small gesture toward a visible target, spend a Blood Trait to deliver a devastating attack without needing to touch them. If the target is aware of the attack, win a normal Physical Challenge with the target bidding three extra Traits due to the difficulty of dodging an unseen strike; if unaware and in incidental physical contact, no challenge is needed. Deals normal hand-to-hand damage and bonuses, and may be combined with other Potence powers like Earthshock; onlookers may notice the connection between your gestures and the destruction with a won Static Mental Challenge.
